fingerprint.own: mean encoder posterior mean over this subject's context
fingerprint.population: equal-person mean of the 17 training-context centroids
fingerprint.wrong: mean of distances for all six other test-context centroids; no pooling their samples
fingerprint.fixed: decoder, target task draws, latent noise, train-only covariance and distance reference
fingerprint.tests: 12 paired two-sided Pratt Wilcoxon tests: 2 dimensions x 2 controls x 3 distances, BH together; seeds averaged within each of 28 subjects
fingerprint.inference_limit: post-review exploratory control; folds have overlapping training sets; within-session context enrollment, no causal/stable-strategy claim

minimum_jerk.input: recorded canonical filtered go-window target (100 x 2) and generated go-window (100 x 2)
minimum_jerk.common_operator: same phase crop by own measured/predicted timing to 100 movement points; physical sample_hz=99/movement_seconds; same lowpass and decomposition
minimum_jerk.interpretation: matched downstream evaluation of the model target representation; upstream acquisition filtering is not undone; true vs predicted timing remains an intended difference
minimum_jerk.selection: historical error-based count selection retained regardless of convergence; all statuses reported, no favorable exclusions
minimum_jerk.starts: deterministic trial-specific seed; real trial ID / original generated run-subject-sample ID
minimum_jerk.sensitivity: first two query trials and first two generated samples per participant, n=3/8 seed42; same input, four restarts and max_nfev700
minimum_jerk.sample_reference: 500 empirical plugin resamples at observed query and n=10 sizes; 3 seed-like draws averaged per subject, no formal null p
